hooks.name: State tests on save
hooks.description: tech.md quality gate, deferred (2026-11-03, to save credits): a save under src/state/** no longer runs tests; the state tests run once, as part of the full suite, when the task is finished.

action.prompt: A file under src/state/ was saved. Do NOT run any tests now: the quality gate is deferred to the end of the task, when you run `npx tsc --noEmit` and the full `npx vitest run` once (that run includes every state test). Reply with the single word "deferred" and then continue the task you were doing in this same turn; do not end the turn here.
